# Uwebly Style

> Official design tokens, stylesheet framework, and UI architecture for Bmdu Studio and the Uwebly ecosystem (uwebly.com, umessage.uwebly.com, velora.uwebly.com).

## Philosophy & Core Rules for AI Assistants

When generating HTML, JSX, or CSS for any application within the BMDU Ecosystem, you MUST strictly adhere to these rules:

1. **Flat Zero-Shadow Architecture**:
   - Strictly NO `box-shadow` or blurry drop-shadows on cards, modals, buttons, or drawers.
   - All visual separation and depth are created solely with `1px solid var(--border)` and contrast between `--bg-color`, `--bg-secondary`, and `--card-bg`.

2. **BMDU Squircle Standard (40%)**:
   - Profile avatars and rounded app icons MUST use `border-radius: 40%` (`var(--radius-avatar)`).
   - NEVER use full circles (`border-radius: 50%`) for user profile avatars.

3. **Strict Border Palette**:
   - Border lines must strictly use `var(--border)` (Light: `#e0e0e0`, Dark: `#333333`).
   - NEVER colorize card or panel container borders with `var(--accent)`.

4. **Dual Theme (Light & Dark)**:
   - Theme is toggled via `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `document.documentElement` (`<html data-theme="...">`).
   - Standard accent color is `#ff42f2` across both themes.

---

## Quickstart & CDN Installation

### Production CDN Tags
```html
<!-- Uwebly Style 3.0 CSS -->
<link
  rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://style.uwebly.com/uwebly3.min.css"
  integrity="sha384-BbkDiRn9IiYi67jlWkpv3YsEWZ0waKl582XgXCqfsEIrw6zT8i9cC//UIMs0xa8/"
  crossorigin="anonymous"
/>

<!-- Uwebly Companion JS Engine (Zero-dependency vanilla interactive helper) -->
<script
  type="module"
  src="https://style.uwebly.com/uwebly.min.js"
  integrity="sha384-wITgPxV4ePOzfIoUFLy7jYeeyRNOqG2CF9iroLYpo8Gt7CsWEqNTK94ZT6QQ6m0G"
  crossorigin="anonymous"
></script>
```

### CSS @import
```css
@import url("https://style.uwebly.com/uwebly3.min.css");
```

---

## CSS Variables (Tokens Matrix)

| Variable | Light | Dark | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg-color` | `#ffffff` | `#121212` | Main page canvas background |
| `--bg-secondary` | `#f4f4f5` | `#1e1e1e` | Secondary canvas, input bg, section bg |
| `--card-bg` | `#ffffff` | `#121212` | Background of cards, modals, dropdowns |
| `--input-bg` | `#f4f4f5` | `#1e1e1e` | Background of form inputs |
| `--hover-bg` | `#f0f0f0` | `#2a2a2a` | Hover state for buttons and list items |
| `--text-color` | `#111111` | `#ffffff` | Primary headings and body text |
| `--text-secondary` | `#71717a` | `#a1a1aa` | Subtitles, labels, descriptions |
| `--text-muted` | `#a1a1aa` | `#71717a` | Timestamps, placeholders, inactive text |
| `--accent` | `#ff42f2` | `#ff42f2` | Signature Uwebly magenta brand accent |
| `--border` | `#e0e0e0` | `#333333` | Standard flat border across all elements |
| `--danger` | `#ff4757` | `#ff4757` | Destructive buttons, error badges |
| `--danger-hover` | `#ff2222` | `#ff2222` | Hover state for destructive actions |
| `--radius-xs` | `4px` | Small tags and badges |
| `--radius-sm` | `8px` | Buttons, dropdown items, inputs |
| `--radius-md` | `12px` | Standard cards, accordions, dropdowns |
| `--radius-lg` | `16px` | Modals, dialogue boxes |
| `--radius-xl` | `24px` | BottomSheet top corners, drawers |
| `--radius-avatar` | `40%` | Official BMDU squircle avatar standard |

---

## Component Reference & HTML Patterns

### 1. Standard Modal & Dialogs
Centered dialog with backdrop blur, smooth scale-in animation, and flat borders.

```html
<!-- Trigger -->
<button data-uwebly-toggle="modal" data-uwebly-target="#confirmModal" class="uwebly-modal-btn btn-primary">
  Open Dialog
</button>

<!-- Modal Container -->
<div id="confirmModal" class="uwebly-modal-overlay">
  <div class="uwebly-modal modal-md">
    <div class="uwebly-modal-header">
      <h3 class="uwebly-modal-title">Confirm Action</h3>
      <button class="uwebly-modal-close" data-uwebly-dismiss="modal">&times;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="uwebly-modal-body">
      <p>Are you sure you want to proceed with this operation?</p>
    </div>
    <div class="uwebly-modal-footer">
      <button class="uwebly-modal-btn btn-cancel" data-uwebly-dismiss="modal">Cancel</button>
      <button class="uwebly-modal-btn btn-primary">Confirm</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
*Modifiers*: `.modal-sm` (360px), `.modal-md` (480px), `.modal-lg` (680px), `.modal-xl` (840px).

---

### 2. Mobile BottomSheet Drawer
Slide-up drawer designed for mobile touch devices with a grab handle bar and 24px top radius.

```html
<!-- Trigger -->
<button data-uwebly-toggle="bottomsheet" data-uwebly-target="#actionSheet" class="notfound-button">
  Open Actions
</button>

<!-- BottomSheet Container -->
<div id="actionSheet" class="uwebly-bottomsheet-overlay">
  <div class="uwebly-bottomsheet">
    <div class="uwebly-bottomsheet-handle"></div>
    <div class="uwebly-bottomsheet-header">
      <h3 class="uwebly-bottomsheet-title">Quick Actions</h3>
      <button class="uwebly-bottomsheet-close" data-uwebly-dismiss="bottomsheet">&times;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="uwebly-bottomsheet-body">
      <button class="uwebly-dropdown-item">Share Link</button>
      <button class="uwebly-dropdown-item">Copy URL</button>
    </div>
    <div class="uwebly-bottomsheet-footer">
      <button class="uwebly-modal-btn btn-cancel" data-uwebly-dismiss="bottomsheet">Close</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

---

### 3. Multi-Directional Scale Dropdown
Contextual popup menu with directional scale animations (`origin-*`) without box-shadow.

```html
<!-- 1. Top-Left Origin (Scales from top-left, opens downwards) -->
<div class="uwebly-dropdown">
  <button data-uwebly-toggle="dropdown" class="notfound-button">Menu ▾</button>
  <div class="uwebly-dropdown-menu origin-top-left">
    <div class="uwebly-dropdown-header">Account</div>
    <a href="#profile" class="uwebly-dropdown-item">Profile</a>
    <a href="#settings" class="uwebly-dropdown-item">Settings</a>
    <div class="uwebly-dropdown-divider"></div>
    <button class="uwebly-dropdown-item danger">Sign Out</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Available Origin Classes:
  .origin-top-left     (Opens down, expands from top-left)
  .origin-top-right    (Opens down, expands from top-right)
  .origin-bottom-left  (Opens up, expands from bottom-left)
  .origin-bottom-right (Opens up, expands from bottom-right)
-->
```

---

### 4. Accordion / Collapse (FAQ)
Expandable accordion with 180° chevron rotation.

```html
<div class="uwebly-accordion">
  <!-- Open Item -->
  <div class="uwebly-accordion-item open">
    <button class="uwebly-accordion-header" data-uwebly-toggle="accordion">
      <span class="uwebly-accordion-title">What is Bmdu Ecosystem?</span>
      <svg class="uwebly-accordion-chevron" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9" />
      </svg>
    </button>
    <div class="uwebly-accordion-collapse">
      <div class="uwebly-accordion-body">
        High-performance web apps built on flat zero-shadow architecture.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Closed Item -->
  <div class="uwebly-accordion-item">
    <button class="uwebly-accordion-header" data-uwebly-toggle="accordion">
      <span class="uwebly-accordion-title">How do I toggle themes?</span>
      <svg class="uwebly-accordion-chevron" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9" />
      </svg>
    </button>
    <div class="uwebly-accordion-collapse">
      <div class="uwebly-accordion-body">
        Add data-uwebly-theme="toggle" to any button to automatically toggle light/dark theme.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

---

### 5. Buttons & Chips
```html
<!-- Primary / Login Button -->
<button class="ee-login-btn">Log In</button>

<!-- Interactive Follow Button -->
<button class="sidebar-follow-btn">Follow</button>
<button class="sidebar-follow-btn following">Following</button>

<!-- Neutral Secondary Button -->
<button class="notfound-button">Secondary Action</button>

<!-- Destructive Danger Button -->
<button class="report-btn-submit">Delete Post</button>
```

---

### 6. User Squircle Avatar & Mention Dropdown
```html
<!-- Squircle Avatar (40% radius) -->
<img src="/avatar.jpg" alt="User" style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 40%; border: 1px solid var(--border);" />

<!-- Search Input Wrapper -->
<div class="search-wrapper">
  <span class="search-icon">🔍</span>
  <input type="text" placeholder="Search..." />
</div>

<!-- Mention List Item -->
<div class="mention-item active">
  <img src="/avatar.jpg" class="mention-avatar" alt="Avatar" />
  <div class="mention-info">
    <span class="mention-name">UFauzan</span>
    <span class="mention-usertag">@umarfauzan11</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

---

### 7. Interactive Theme Toggle Button
```html
<!-- Simply add data-uwebly-theme="toggle" -->
<button data-uwebly-theme="toggle" class="notfound-button">
  Toggle Theme
</button>
```

---

## JavaScript API (uwebly.min.js)

The global `window.Uwebly` helper provides programmatic control:

```javascript
// Theme
Uwebly.setTheme('dark'); // 'light' | 'dark'
Uwebly.getTheme();       // returns current theme

// Modal
Uwebly.showModal('#myModal');
Uwebly.hideModal('#myModal');

// BottomSheet
Uwebly.showBottomSheet('#mySheet');
Uwebly.hideBottomSheet('#mySheet');

// Toast Notification
Uwebly.toast('Changes saved successfully!', 3000);
```
